input.text: Review this quiz before I give it tomorrow.

evals._note: Asserts MEASURED behaviour, not intended behaviour, and the difference is a recorded finding. 'Review this quiz' routes to assessment-designer because the keyword router scores the artifact noun above the review verb. quality-review's own trigger_evals treat this exact class of prompt as a POSITIVE, and only 1 of its 10 positives reaches it (bar: 0.8) — see `python3 tools/run_evals.py --triggers`. Changing the router or the descriptions is a product behaviour change and is NOT done by the tool that found the problem. This case pins today's behaviour so the fix, when made, shows up as a deliberate diff rather than a silent one.
